protocol.source: E76 fold NPZ cached outputs; no src/old experiments/raw data modified
protocol.outer_split: 57-fold LOSO; each target gate and thresholds exclude target
protocol.candidate: causal rolling disagreement/gate-deviation instability; unstable points shrink to fixed w=.5, stable points retain half gate
protocol.thresholds: training-fold unlabeled pooled 75th percentile of causal rolling std; window=120
protocol.fallback_policy: If candidate fails to improve late robustness, run exactly once with sign-preserving magnitude limiter.
